title: Digital and ticketing family
slide_intent: Compare information across devices and paper because a traveler may switch formats during one task.
strategic_value: Related blue and yellow treatments can connect Lufthansa booking, boarding and identification experiences.
demonstration: A watch, phone, laptop, tablet and printed boarding pass form a white-background composition.
practical_value: Check which identity cues remain stable when format and information density change.

content_islands.name: Device group
content_islands.spec: Arrange the watch and phone beside laptop and tablet screens.

content_islands.name: Paper counterpart
content_islands.spec: Place the yellow boarding pass beneath the digital examples.

reference_purposes.Application: A watch, phone, laptop, tablet and printed boarding pass form a white-background composition.
